text: Ocean Pantry: Area 3
Aba
Akula
Pelulu
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
BOSS BATTLE\nGet Aba under control!!
Uh, we've reached the innermost area of the Ocean\nPantry! There are lots of treasures that will help\nus make lots of frenz!
Ugh, you've really been leading us on a wild goose\nchase. Since we've come this far, lemme at least\nget one treasure!
Alright, here I come~!
You've got to be kidding me! It's all just glass\nbeads over here, too!
But they're all super big, rite?\nUh, I picked each one really, really carefully,\nyou know!
I don't care if they're big or small.\nThey're still just glass!
Oh?!\nNow this is the real deal! A true treasure!!
A heartfelt essay from a daughter expressing her\ngratitude to her father!! *sob*\nIs it even possible not to be moved by this?!
Okay, let's see what it says.
Oh, c'mon!
Ohhh! Right! Adding a glass bead to the bottled\nletter as a lil' souvenir will increase our\nchances of making frenz!
I want my chances of getting treasure to go\nthrough the roof too!
Grrr...\nThe nerve of these humans! They really don't know\ntheir place...
Well, whatever. Back to the essay...\nI love my father.\nHe's very big and I can always count on him.
Boohoo~!\nI love you so much too!
Umm, let's see what else is written...I love my\nfather because he's also very good at cooking.\nHe's super big and I can always count on him.
Boohoo~!\nI'm gonna be extra generous for tonight's dinner!\nIt's my treat!
Okay, let's see what else...He knows so much, and\nhe tells me all sorts of stories. He's also super\nbig, and I can always count on him.
Aww~...Such a sweet, innocent little girl!\nIf there's anything you don't understand,\njust leave it to Daddy!
You see that?!\nThis is the bond between a father and a daughter!\nIt will never lose to something like friendship!
Now reflect on how cocky you were earlier, and\nadmit your defeat...
Wow! Pelulu, you're a glass bead billionaire!
That doesn't make me happy at all!
Boohoo...I can't believe you aren't even\nlistening...
Look what you've done to her! She used to be such\na good kid! You're a terrible influence on her!\nShe became like this because of you!
Wait, what?!\nWhat's gotten into this geezer all of a sudden?!
Poppa?
Give back my pure and innocent Akula!!\nYou horrible humans!!
Boohoo...\nI can't believe I lost to a mere human...
Hey, what's your problem?!\nAttacking out of nowhere like that!
Poppa, did you get an owie?
Ugh...
Uh, stay here!
Oh, Akula...
What's that?
Ointment for wounds! Poppa's skin is really rough,\nso I collected some special ointment made from\nSlimy Moss for him!
Oh, my dear Akula...\nYou've grown into such a caring child. You truly\ncare about your father.
Looks like meeting you was good for her after all.
Hmm, I'll make an exception for you guys!\nYou guys can be friends with Akula!
Look at him, talking like he's the boss!
Okay, bye, Akula!\nHope you won't mind if we stop by again!
Uh, of course! My frenz can come over whenever!
Sheesh...Glass beads, glass beads, glass beads...\nThere was nothing but glass beads...This has got\nto be the most disappointing haul ever!
What now?\nDon't tell me you're planning to follow us!
Hmm, you're Akula's friend...\nNo doubt about that...
But I should be your first stop!\nBefore you talk to Akula, make sure you come to me\nfirst!
I'll be keeping a close eye on you to make sure\nnothing goes wrong!
I can't deal with this geezer!
Hey! Why are you running away?!\nYou must have made plans with Akula behind my\nback, I knew it!
Grrr...This is unforgivable!!!
Stop following us!
You're not getting away!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go to Rahulik Beach!
Explore the Ocean Pantry a bit more!
